name: Litago (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow fly part bearing a red cross offset towards the hoist, charged at the hoist with a yellow tower with a cross of Saint James and crossed swords.
history: Municipal flag of Litago; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross on the yellow part with its vertical arm along the division
tower with a cross of Saint James, between crossed swords
